user.title: Connect your Samsung TV
user.description: HomeHub Media controls the TV directly over your local network. If the Samsung Smart TV integration is set up, its address is filled in for you.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the TV, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.mac: Optional. Lets HomeHub turn the TV on with Wake-on-LAN. Read from the TV when left empty.

pair.title: Allow HomeHub on the TV
pair.description: Make sure the TV at {host} is on. Select **Submit**, then press **Allow** on the TV within 30 seconds.

reconfigure.title: Change the TV connection
reconfigure.description: Update the TV address. You will pair with the TV again on the next screen.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the TV.
data_description.mac: Optional. Lets HomeHub turn the TV on with Wake-on-LAN. Read from the TV when left empty.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV. Check that it is on and on the same network.
error.pairing_denied: The TV did not allow HomeHub. Try again and press Allow on the TV, or check Settings > General > External Device Manager > Device Connection Manager.
error.invalid_host: Enter a host name, an IPv4 address, or an IPv6 address in square brackets.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a MAC address such as aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HomeHub Media is already set up. Only one instance is supported.

init.title: HomeHub Media options
init.description: Everything here is optional. Open a section, make changes, then choose **Save and close** to apply them all.

menu_option_descriptions.tv: TV media player entity and the address the TV uses to reach Home Assistant.
menu_option_descriptions.apps: Which apps the remote shows and their TV app IDs.
menu_option_descriptions.servers: Continue watching, recently added and now playing.
menu_option_descriptions.box: An Android TV or similar box on one of the TV inputs.
menu_option_descriptions.pc: The HomeHub media PC (ambient player and app coordinator).
menu_option_descriptions.keyboard: The ESP32 Bluetooth keyboard for typing into apps.
menu_option_descriptions.ambience: Where ambience plays and your internet radio stations.
menu_option_descriptions.modes: Add, edit or remove ambience modes and their lighting.
menu_option_descriptions.dayparts: When each part of the day starts and which mode it suggests.
menu_option_descriptions.assistant: An AI model that can control the TV and ambience by voice.
menu_option_descriptions.done: Save every change made in this dialog.

tv.title: TV
tv.description: Optional helpers for the TV itself.

data.base_url: Home Assistant URL for the TV

data_description.entity: A media player for the TV, for example from the Samsung Smart TV integration. Needed to switch inputs by source name and to read the volume.
data_description.app_entity: An entity whose state is the app running on the TV, if you have one.
data_description.base_url: How the TV reaches Home Assistant to show ambience, for example http://192.168.1.10:8123. Leave empty to use the internal URL.

apps.title: Streaming apps
apps.description: Choose the apps to show on the remote. Tick **Rescan TV apps** to detect what is installed.

data_description.enabled: Apps shown on the remote card.
data_description.overrides: Optional. TV app IDs as app=id pairs separated by commas, for example netflix=3201907018807, youtube=111299001912.
data_description.rescan: Ask the TV which apps are installed and fill in the fields above. Nothing is saved until you submit without this ticked.

servers.title: Plex and Jellyfin
servers.description: Pick a media server to set up.

plex.title: Plex
plex.description: Leave the URL empty to turn Plex off.

data_description.player: Optional. Only follow players whose name contains this text, for example Samsung.
data_description.prefill: Copies the server URL and token from the Plex integration already set up in Home Assistant. Only used when ticked.

jellyfin.title: Jellyfin
jellyfin.description: Leave the URL empty to turn Jellyfin off. You choose the user on the next screen.

data_description.api_key: Create one in the Jellyfin dashboard under API Keys.

jellyfin_user.title: Jellyfin user
jellyfin_user.description: Whose continue watching list should HomeHub show?

data_description.user_id: The Jellyfin user whose library is shown.
data_description.player: Optional. Only follow players whose name contains this text, for example Samsung.

box.title: Streaming box
box.description: Leave the remote empty to turn the streaming box off.

data_description.remote: The remote entity that sends keys to the box, for example from the Android TV Remote integration.
data_description.media_player: Optional. Used to tune channels and show what is playing.

input.name: TV input
input.description: How the TV switches to the box.

data_description.method: Remote key works without a TV media player. Source name needs the TV media player from the TV section.
data_description.value: A key such as KEY_HDMI1, or a source name such as HDMI 1.

pc.title: Media PC
pc.description: Leave the host empty to turn the media PC off. The tokens are in the PC's HomeHub config files.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the media PC.
data_description.ambient_token: Bearer token of the ambient player.
data_description.coord_token: Bearer token of the media hub coordinator.
data_description.clients: App names the coordinator can open, for example jellyfin. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

input.name: TV input
input.description: How the TV switches to the media PC.

data_description.method: Remote key works without a TV media player. Source name needs the TV media player from the TV section.
data_description.value: A key such as KEY_HDMI2, or a source name such as HDMI 2.

keyboard.title: Keyboard bridge
keyboard.description: Leave the host empty to turn the keyboard bridge off.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the ESP32 keyboard bridge.
data_description.key: The shared key set in the bridge firmware.

ambience.title: Ambience
ambience.description: Where ambience plays, and internet radio stations to use as soundtracks.

data_description.backend: The media PC is offered once it is set up.
data_description.radio: One station per line as id=https://url, for example jazz=https://example.com/stream. IDs use lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

modes.title: Ambience modes
modes.description: Pick a mode to edit or remove, or add a new one.

mode.title: Ambience mode
mode.description: Lighting for this mode. Visuals and sound are chosen on the card.

data_description.name: Shown on the card. New modes get their ID from the name.
data_description.scene: Optional. Activated when the mode starts; the previous lighting comes back when it stops.
data_description.flicker: Optional. Lights that flicker like a fire while the mode runs.
data_description.lights_only: Only change the lighting; play no visuals or sound.
data_description.delete: Remove this mode when you submit.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Volume levels used when an activity starts.

data_description.normal: TV volume when an activity starts.
data_description.quiet: TV volume while quiet mode is on.
data_description.block_entity: Optional. While this entity is on, HomeHub leaves the volume alone.

dayparts.title: Times of day
dayparts.description: When each part of the day starts and which ambience mode auto ambience uses then.

data_description.idle_minutes: Minutes without remote use before auto ambience starts.

data_description.mode: Optional. Ambience mode for the morning.
Optional. Ambience mode for the afternoon.
Optional. Ambience mode for the evening.
Optional. Ambience mode for the night.

assistant.title: Voice assistant
assistant.description: Adds a conversation agent that can control the TV, apps and ambience. Pick it in your voice assistant settings afterwards.

data_description.provider: Ollama runs locally. OpenAI and Claude need an API key and send your requests to that service.

assistant_auth.title: Connect the assistant
assistant_auth.description: The provider's software is installed when you submit, which can take a minute.

data_description.api_key: Stored in Home Assistant and only sent to the provider.

data_description.model: The model that answers. You can also type a model name.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address and that the device or service is running.
error.invalid_auth: The token, key or password was rejected.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid URL. Radio stations need one id=https://url per line.
error.invalid_id: Use app=id pairs with known apps and IDs of letters, digits, '.', '-' or '_'.
error.invalid_host: Enter a host name, an IPv4 address, or an IPv6 address in square brackets.
error.invalid_input: Enter a key such as KEY_HDMI1, or a source name when switching by source.
error.tv_entity_required: Switching inputs by source name needs the TV media player. Set it in the TV section first, or switch by remote key.
error.mode_exists: A mode with this name already exists.

remote.name: Remote
remote.description: Sends a remote control command to the TV, streaming box or media PC.

command.name: Command
command.description: The button to press, for example up, select or play_pause.

target.name: Target
target.description: Device to send it to. Defaults to the current activity. Volume always goes to the TV.

send_key.name: Send TV key
send_key.description: Sends a raw Samsung remote key to the TV.

key.name: Key
key.description: Samsung key name, for example KEY_HDMI1.

hold_secs.name: Hold time
hold_secs.description: Seconds to hold the key down (0-5).

launch_app.name: Launch app
launch_app.description: Opens a streaming app on the TV.

app.name: App
app.description: App name such as netflix, or a TV app ID.

restart_app.name: Restart app
restart_app.description: Closes and reopens an app on the TV.

app.name: App
app.description: App name such as netflix, or a TV app ID.

send_text.name: Send text
send_text.description: Types text into the app on screen.

target.name: Target
target.description: Where to type. Defaults to the best option for the current activity.

keyboard_key.name: Keyboard key
keyboard_key.description: Presses backspace, enter or clear on the active keyboard.

target.name: Target
target.description: Where to send it. Defaults to the best option for the current activity.

pointer.name: Pointer
pointer.description: Moves or clicks the on-screen pointer.

dx.name: Horizontal distance
dx.description: Pixels to move right (negative moves left).

dy.name: Vertical distance
dy.description: Pixels to move down (negative moves up), or the scroll amount.

target.name: Target
target.description: tv or pc. Defaults to the current activity.

set_activity.name: Set activity
set_activity.description: Switches between off, the TV, the streaming box and the media PC.

force.name: Force
force.description: Switch inputs again even if the activity is already active.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Tunes the streaming box to a channel number.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: ID of the ambience mode, for example fireplace.

ambience_stop.name: Stop ambience
ambience_stop.description: Stops ambience and restores the lighting.

ambience_update.name: Update ambience
ambience_update.description: Changes what the running ambience plays.

visual.name: Visual
visual.description: ID of the video to show.

video_random_start.name: Random video start
video_random_start.description: Start the video at a random point.

original_volume.name: Video volume
original_volume.description: Volume of the video's own sound (0-100).

soundtrack.name: Soundtrack
soundtrack.description: ID of the soundtrack or radio station.

soundtrack_random_start.name: Random soundtrack start
soundtrack_random_start.description: Start the soundtrack at a random point.

save_mode.name: Save mode
save_mode.description: Saves visuals and sound as the default for an ambience mode.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: ID of the ambience mode to save.

visual.name: Visual
visual.description: ID of the video to show.

video_random_start.name: Random video start
video_random_start.description: Start the video at a random point.

original_volume.name: Video volume
original_volume.description: Volume of the video's own sound (0-100).

soundtrack.name: Soundtrack
soundtrack.description: ID of the soundtrack or radio station.

soundtrack_random_start.name: Random soundtrack start
soundtrack_random_start.description: Start the soundtrack at a random point.

set_favorite.name: Set favorite
set_favorite.description: Marks a visual or soundtrack as a favorite.

media_id.name: Media ID
media_id.description: ID of the visual or soundtrack.

favorite.name: Favorite
favorite.description: On to add, off to remove.

ambience_auto.name: Auto ambience
ambience_auto.description: Starts the ambience mode for the current time of day.

ambience_sleep_timer.name: Ambience sleep timer
ambience_sleep_timer.description: Fades out and stops ambience after a while.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Minutes until ambience stops (0 cancels the timer).

refresh_catalog.name: Refresh catalog
refresh_catalog.description: Scans the media folder for new visuals and soundtracks.

rescan_apps.name: Rescan apps
rescan_apps.description: Asks the TV which streaming apps are installed.

play_library_item.name: Play library item
play_library_item.description: Opens Plex or Jellyfin on the TV and plays an item.

item_id.name: Item ID
item_id.description: ID of the movie or episode on that server.

pc_open.name: Open media PC app
pc_open.description: Opens an app on the media PC.

client.name: App
client.description: App name as set in the media PC options, for example jellyfin.

pc_close.name: Close media PC app
pc_close.description: Closes the app open on the media PC.
